mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual pathways was most worthwhile: the contrast between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it made the transformation clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate cornea and lens fittings felt repetitive because neither result explained its contribution until the iris was added.
